terms.title: Commercial terms
terms.intro: The defaults a new quote or order of this customer takes.
terms.saved: Commercial terms saved. Open quotes keep theirs; new quotes and orders take these.
terms.noList: None: priced from the base list
terms.typedOnly: Typed on the customer, not from the library
terms.noPrice: The minimum order value is not in your role (no selling prices).
terms.currencyHint: Its quotes and price list are in this currency.
terms.paymentHint: What is paid when; the deposit follows the order instalment.
terms.listHint: Active lists in {currency} of this company or every company.
terms.groupHint: Read only: a customer joins a discount group by getting the group's list (or a list that falls back to it).
terms.carrierHint: The carrier code its shipments use first (e.g. BRT, GLS).
terms.depositHint: Percent of the gross total; empty: from its payment terms, else the sales settings.
terms.minimumHint: Net, in {currency}; a quote under it says so.
terms.languageHint: The language its quotes, PDFs and mails are written in.
terms.invoicingHint: TD01 an invoice per shipment, TD24 one deferred invoice a month.
terms.choicesFailed: Couldn't read the payment terms or the price lists to pick from: the other fields still save.

held.archived: Archived: reactivate it to change its terms
held.noManage: Your role can see customers, not change them
held.noTerms: Your role cannot read the payment terms library
held.noListsManage: Giving a price list needs the right to keep price lists

problem.currency: A currency code such as EUR or CHF
problem.minimum: An amount with at most two decimals

refused.moved: Someone else changed this customer meanwhile: read again, nothing was overwritten.
refused.forbidden: Your role may not give this list or these terms.
refused.list: That price list cannot be this customer's: it must be active, of its company or every company, and in its currency.
refused.terms: Those payment terms cannot be used: archived, or of another company.
refused.currency: The currency does not fit its price list: change both together.
refused.fields: Some fields were refused: check them.
refused.unavailable: The server did not answer: nothing was changed, try again.
refused.internal: Something went wrong on the server: nothing was changed.

incoterm.CIP: CIP · Carriage and Insurance Paid To

held.manage: Your role can see customers, not change them
held.run: Importing needs the right to run imports and upload files

read.signed_out: Your session ended: sign in again.
read.not_found: It is not there any more.
read.unavailable: The server did not answer: try again in a moment.
read.rate_limited: Too many requests: wait a moment.
read.contract: The answer did not match this page: reload the page.
read.internal: Something went wrong on the server.

answer.nothingSet: nothing set yet: a new quote takes the sales settings
answer.noTerms: no payment terms set (a new quote takes the sales settings)
answer.fallback: The terms with each company could not be read: these are the customer's own terms.

chip.waitHold_one: {count} accepted quote waits for the hold
chip.waitHold_other: {count} accepted quotes wait for the hold
chip.waitPo_one: {count} accepted quote waits for a PO number
chip.waitPo_other: {count} accepted quotes wait for a PO number
chip.noIdentity: No tax identity: it cannot be invoiced
chip.viesInvalid: VIES: not valid — Italian VAT applies
chip.viesUnchecked: VAT number not checked with VIES

hold.none: Not on hold: new orders and shipments go ahead.

answer.every: On hold since {date}, for every company ({reason}).

stops.every: New orders and shipments of {customer} wait until the hold is released.
stops.with: New orders and shipments with {companies} wait until the hold is released.
stops.desc: Quotes go on, with a warning on each. Invoices and payments go on as usual.

hold.placedOnCheck: Placed on {date} by a credit check: “{words}”
hold.another: Put on hold for another reason…
hold.waitingTitle_one: Waiting for the release: {count} accepted quote has no order yet
hold.waitingTitle_other: Waiting for the release: {count} accepted quotes have no order yet
hold.waitingList: Accepted quotes waiting for the release
hold.waitingHint: Releasing makes no order by itself: make them in

info.what: Hold: stops this customer's new orders and shipments — for one company or for every company — with a reason people read on the quote, the order and the shipment. Quotes go on with a warning; invoices and payments go on.
info.release: Releasing a hold makes no order by itself: the accepted quotes that waited are made into orders from Quotes › Accepted, order waits.
info.block: Block… in the record's ⋯ is a different stop (the whole record). A credit limit is Money's.

com.answer: New quotes and orders take these; open ones keep their own.
com.shownFor: Shown for {company}, the company you work in; each company is below.
com.nothingSet: Nothing set yet: a new quote takes the sales settings' payment terms and deposit, in EUR and Italian, invoiced per shipment (TD01); we pay the freight.
com.ptNone: None: a new quote takes the sales settings
com.languageSub: Its quotes, PDFs and mails, when the contact has none
com.incotermSub: For Intrastat; a quote or order keeps its own
com.noService: No default service: picked per shipment
com.foot: What the customer sees: its portal Account page shows its payment terms and currency, read only, with “Something wrong? Ask us”.
com.footMulti: What the customer sees: its portal Account page shows the customer's own payment terms and currency, read only, with “Something wrong? Ask us”.
com.companiesList: Terms with each of our companies

info.what: Commercial terms: what a NEW quote or order of this customer takes. Each quote and order keeps its own copy: changing the terms here never changes them.
info.companies: With two or more of our companies, a company may have its own payment terms, price list, deposit and PO rule; the rest comes from the customer (“Customer default”).
info.po: Customer PO number: when it is required, an order without it waits (the order of an accepted quote) or is refused (a typed or imported order).
info.copies: The currency is the one of its price lists and portal; the delivery terms feed Intrastat. Neither is copied to a quote or order yet.

freight.COLLECT: The customer pays, on its own account (porto assegnato)
freight.THIRD_PARTY: Someone else pays, on their own account

co.backHeld: A credit limit is set with {company} (Money): its own terms stay while the limit is set.

problem.terms: Pick its payment terms from the library, or use the customer's.
problem.list: Pick its price list, or use the customer's.

co.poSaved: The PO number rule was saved for {company}.

problem.number: The account number is the carrier's: 3 to 40 letters, digits, spaces, dots, slashes or hyphens.
problem.numberEmpty: Type the new number, or keep the account on file.
problem.needsAccount: The customer or someone else pays only on its own account with the carrier: give the account, or let us pay.
problem.needsCarrier: A service or an account is of one carrier: pick the carrier.

deliv.saved: Delivery saved: new shipments of {customer} book {carrier}.
deliv.savedAccount: Delivery saved: new shipments of {customer} book {carrier} on its own account.
deliv.savedEnds: Delivery saved: new shipments of {customer} book {carrier} on its own account, ending {ends}.
deliv.savedNone: Delivery saved: new shipments of {customer} take the carrier picked for each.

end.po: The PO number rule goes too: orders with {company} will no longer need the customer's PO number.
end.openKeep: Open quotes and orders keep their own.
end.done: The terms with {company} ended: new quotes and orders take the customer's.
end.refusedCredit: A credit limit is set with this company meanwhile: its own terms stay while the limit is set.

ct.copied: Copied: a link that opens this part of the tab.
ct.keys: Keys: Tab moves from row to row · Enter opens the row's ⋯ · Esc closes a menu or a window.

win.listByColleague: The price list is given by a colleague who keeps price lists.

terms.title: Change the terms of {customer}
terms.sub: The customer's own terms: what a new quote or order takes
terms.note: {companies} keep their own payment terms or deposit: those stay. Change them with Set terms for {company}…
terms.ptHint: Empty: a new quote takes the sales settings
terms.currencyHint: Its price lists and portal; a list in another currency changes with it

timing.PER_SHIPMENT: Each shipment is invoiced on its own
timing.MONTHLY: The month's shipments in one deferred invoice

terms.group: Discount group: {group} — it comes with the price list.
terms.oneCommand: One command (the terms save) at the customer's version. The carrier is no longer here: it is in Change delivery…

deliv.title: Change the delivery of {customer}
deliv.sub: How its goods travel: one command (the carrier account)
deliv.carrierHint: The carrier its shipments use first

pays.COLLECT: The customer pays, on its own account
pays.THIRD_PARTY: Someone else pays, on their own account

paysSub.SENDER: On our own contract or at the platform's rates
paysSub.COLLECT: Porto assegnato: the label is billed to its account with the carrier
paysSub.THIRD_PARTY: For example a brand paying for its dealer

accountSub.replace: Type the new number: it is sealed, the old one deleted
accountSub.remove: The freight comes back to us

deliv.numberHint: Needed when the customer or another payer pays. It is sealed: nobody reads it again.
deliv.another: Another carrier needs its own account: changing the carrier removes the account and the service.
deliv.foot: Labels bought from now use these; labels already bought keep theirs.

co.title: Set terms for {company}
co.depositHint: Percent of the gross total, above 0 and at most 100
co.poHint: An order with {company} without it waits (from a quote) or is refused (typed).
co.oneCommand: One command for {company} (its terms row, at its version); the result is said for {company} only.
co.foot: New quotes and orders with {company} take these; open ones keep their own.

po.oneCommand: One command for {company} (its terms row), with its own result.
po.foot: Open orders keep their own PO number, or none.

end.title: Back to the customer's terms with {company}?
end.what: {company} stops using its own terms: new quotes and orders with it take the customer's. The ended terms stay under “Ended company terms”.

req.title: Requirements
req.ddtSome_one: {count} printed on the delivery note (DDT); the rest kept, not on the other screens yet
req.ddtSome_other: {count} printed on the delivery note (DDT); the rest kept, not on the other screens yet
req.ddtNone: none on the delivery note (DDT): kept, not on the other screens yet
req.ddtUnless: Unless the office types its own remarks
req.keptOne: Kept for {stages} — not on that screen yet
req.keptMany: Kept for {stages} — not on those screens yet
req.fileFailed: The file could not be opened: try again.
req.hideEnded: Hide the ended and replaced ones
req.replacedBy: v{version} · replaced by v{next} on {date} by {name}: “{reason}”
req.replacedByBare: v{version} · replaced by v{next} on {date} by {name}
req.searchStylesHint: This customer's styles and our own collection, searched on the server

info.what: Requirements: the brand's own rules for packing, labels, documents, shipping, quality and invoicing. A rule is never edited: a change ends the old one and starts a new version in one step.
info.where: Today only the shipping rules reach a paper (the delivery note's remarks). The quote, order, pick & pack, checklist and invoice screens will read them in a later job.
info.styles: A rule names styles of this customer or of our own collection only.
